stations.title: Bryn
stations.say: Why is shelf B empty? Nobody counted

stations.title: Packing code
stations.text: Uses a value before it knows its kind.

captions: Bryn asks why the packing code says a shelf at Oakhollow is empty.
Nobody has counted shelf B yet, and the code used its count anyway.
You make each function check which kind of value it holds before using it.
Now shelf B waits for its count, and only a shelf with no tins shows as empty.
Every function knows the kind of its value, and a new kind of delivery is caught.
